stage_when_written: full calibration in progress; no independent test readout yet
secondary_prediction: prediction (greedy free generation; invalid answers count as errors)
target_layer_selection: For each task/path, maximize mean calibration balanced accuracy over all seven source layers and both control images; tie -> shallowest q.
summary_source_layer_selection: After q is frozen, choose one source layer per task/path by mean calibration candidate balanced accuracy over both controls; tie -> shallowest l. Do not choose it from test results.
full_test_curves: Still report every source boundary 0..18 under the fixed q, with per-control metrics and grouped uncertainty.
summary_uncertainty: 1000 paired bootstrap draws of complete independent scene groups, preserving both control images, counterfactual pairs/quads and real/control correspondence.
interpretation_limits: readout under the selected frozen decoder; not proof of action-policy use
single-token failure is not proof of absent information
closed-set decoding is not free-form hidden-state explanation
